about.intro: We design and build websites that look sharp, load fast and help brands grow.
about.story: EDGE is a web design and development team. We build fast, animated websites on Webflow, Framer, Figma and WordPress, and help brands look sharp online.
about.approach: You talk to us first, we agree the scope and price, and the same specialist stays with your project from design to launch.

values.title: Design that sells
values.text: Every layout has a job: earn trust and turn visitors into clients.

values.title: Speed and polish
values.text: Fast load times, smooth motion and details that feel premium.

values.title: Clear communication
values.text: You always know what is happening, what it costs and what is next.
